title: Known signed Pauli handles tolerate first local bath motion in the averaged channel
statement: For known unit gains, each fresh even-sign cycle has chronological segments B(-sB),C(-sC),B(sB),C(sC),A(-sA),C(-sC),B(-sB),C(sC),B(sB),A(sA), all durationd, withsC=sA*sB. Its frozen cubic term is-4i*d^3*Z1X2; moving second-order survivors are retained as bath-only evolution, while the averaged joint channel has a uniform O(d^4) remainder including channel variance. Composition gives the target after final memory trace for arbitrary DMR correlations, with durationO(epsilon^-2), segmentsO(epsilon^-3) and stated finite precision. No second/higher bath derivative or bath norm is used. Conditioning later control on inner sign histories would require a new record-aware argument.
